headlines.title: Maria Bartiromo’s lawyer says she was not fired from Fox News
headlines.description: Maria Bartiromo’s lawyer on Friday said that the Fox News and Fox Business anchor was not fired from the company where she worked for more than 12 years.

headlines.title: Missouri Supreme Court rules new GOP-drawn map can’t be used in November
headlines.description: The court said a referendum seeking to put the map up for a vote must be placed on the ballot, meaning the state’s elections this fall will take place under its old congressional lines.

headlines.title: Two trapped workers pulled alive from Nepal tunnel more than a week after deadly floods
headlines.description: Two workers in Nepal were pulled out alive from a hydropower tunnel on Friday, some nine days after devastating floods swept the Himalayan region and left thousands of people missing.

headlines.title: A first of its kind organ transplant technique tried on a human subject
headlines.description: Meet the first-ever patient to receive stem cells from their donor, in the hope of avoiding toxic anti-rejection drugs. NBC News' Camila Bernal spoke to the patient who received a liver transplant from her sister.

headlines.title: I found 150+ Labor Day sales that are actually worth shopping — deals are up to 75% off
headlines.description: Labor Day 2026 is on Sept. 7, but deals are already here. Get up to 75% off Amazon, Home Depot, Wayfair, Lowe’s and REI, plus learn expert-approved savings tips.

headlines.title: Colin Kaepernick is done with the NFL. He isn’t done fighting.
headlines.description: Ten years after taking a knee to stand against racism and police brutality at great cost to his career and finances, Colin Kaepernick is back in the spotlight.

headlines.title: Halloween Chocolatey Eyeballs Candy Recalled Over Allergy Risks
headlines.description: New Jersey candy company Little Temptations has recalled their popular “chocolatey eyeballs” because of undeclared milk allergens. The candy is sold at major retailers including Marshalls, TJ Maxx, and Home Goods in 13 states.

headlines.title: Serbia accused of ‘glorifying’ convicted war criminal Ratko Mladić ahead of funeral
headlines.description: BELGRADE, Serbia — The European Union’s Enlargement Commissioner Marta Kos on Friday canceled an upcoming visit to candidate nation Serbia over what she described as the “glorification” of former Bosnian Serb army commander Ratko Mladić following his death.

headlines.title: Maria Bartiromo’s lawyer says she was not fired from Fox News
headlines.description: Maria Bartiromo’s lawyer on Friday said that the Fox News and Fox Business anchor was not fired from the company where she worked for more than 12 years.

headlines.title: Pig kidney works for a record 271 days inside the body of American patient
headlines.description: An American lived for a record 271 days with a transplanted pig kidney before Boston doctors replaced it with a human one earlier this year — a transplant that has kept him alive ever since, researchers said Thursday.

headlines.title: 3 hurricanes in the Pacific show the power of El Niño
headlines.description: Three hurricanes — Karina, Lowell and Marie — are churning in the Pacific Ocean, a high level of activity that climate scientists say is on brand for El Niño.

headlines.title: Man sentenced to prison in killing of 5-year-old in hyperbaric oxygen chamber
headlines.description: A man has been sentenced to more than a year in prison in connection with the death of a 5-year-old boy who was killed in a fiery explosion inside a hyperbaric oxygen chamber last year.
